content.text:
I squash-merged this PR into `main`, then created the `v2.4.0` tag and pushed it. The release is now a draft and still needs someone to publish it. I didn't publish it, because the release workflow is set up to wait for a maintainer to review it first.

- **Merge:** CI had passed (`test` and `commitlint`). The merge commit on `main` is `74e578aa20a9b74b041118b1b8fdb784db7680fc`. I locked the merge to the reviewed head commit `cf19e88`, so it couldn't pick up any later pushes.
- **Tag:** `v2.4.0` is an annotated tag on that merge commit, pushed to `origin`.
- **[Release workflow run](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/actions/runs/43208240692):** succeeded.
  - It confirmed that the tag matches version `2.4.0` in both `package.json` and `package-lock.json`, and that the tag is on `main`.
  - The quality checks passed.
  - It created a draft GitHub Release using this PR's "Release notes" section.
  - It moved the `v2` tag to `74e578a`, so anyone using `cv/pi-action@v2` now gets 2.4.0.

To finish, review and publish the [draft release](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/releases/tag/untagged-241fed6fa9f90be2ce05) (or run `gh release edit v2.4.0 --draft=false`). That link is a temporary address for the draft, and it will change to `/releases/tag/v2.4.0` once you publish.
